_readme: Catoshi's Catch server settings. Edit this file, then restart the server (npm start). Leave wallet addresses empty until launch; nothing on-chain happens while mode is 'play'.
_mode: 'play' = $CATOSHI is a play balance kept by the server. 'live' is reserved for the token launch and is not wired to the chain yet.

server._publicUrl: The https address players open, e.g. https://catoshi.example.com. Used for the Phantom mobile deep link.

wallets._wallets: Public addresses only. Never put a private key in this file.
wallets._payout: The wallet prizes are paid from once live payouts are switched on.

splits._splits: Where each kind of spending goes. Each row must add up to 1.

seed._seed: Catoshi's starting treasury, added once when the server first starts with an empty data folder.
